notes.zh-Hans:
修复校准后的视频启动和过期画面处理。实时视频不再自动回退到传输全部历史视频缓冲，避免此前接近三分钟的启动等待。模型请求会等待当前捕获的画面；画面过期时显示视频错误，不再基于旧画面操作。数据丢失或重新连接后重置解码，并等待完整关键帧。

无需更新 ESP32 固件或重新输入 API 密钥。启动任务后返回主屏幕，检查操作是否开始并跟随当前画面。若视频无法追上实时进度，应用应报告失败，而不是长时间停留在零步骤。iOS 27.2 beta 真机验证仍待完成。
notes.en-US:
Fixes video startup and stale-screen handling after calibration. Live streaming no longer falls back to transferring the entire buffered video history, which caused a nearly three-minute startup delay. Model requests now wait for current captured frames and stop with a video error instead of using outdated screens. Video decoding resets after lost data or reconnection and waits for a complete keyframe.

No ESP32 firmware update or API-key re-entry is required. Start a task and return to Home; check that actions begin and follow current screen content. If video cannot catch up, the app should report a failure instead of remaining at zero steps for minutes. Physical verification on iOS 27.2 beta is still pending.
